Yejin Choi TED 2023 common sense moonshot transcript

sources_considered.why: The February 2023 version documents an active research dispute and identifies unresolved limitations.
Six researchers jointly articulate a substantive limitation of contemporary language models.
read_page returned the talk description but not the transcript needed to verify the quoted position.
read_page returned HTTP 403; the accessible arXiv version was used instead.

evidence_items.locator: Opening discussion, paragraph beginning 'As impressive as they are'

receipt.public_excerpt: As impressive as they are, state-of-the-art LLMs remain susceptible to brittleness and unhumanlike errors.

evidence_items.explanation: Mitchell and Krakauer describe competing research camps and unresolved questions about understanding. This supports the existence of substantive disagreement, rather than unanimous acceptance of a completed victory.

receipt.public_excerpt: In short, LLMs are good models of language but incomplete models of human thought.

evidence_items.explanation: Mahowald, Ivanova, Blank, Kanwisher, Tenenbaum, and Fedorenko jointly argue that successful language modeling leaves important cognitive abilities unresolved. Their position supports Marcus's contextual claim that skepticism extended beyond him.

unresolved_gaps: These sources do not measure how many researchers endorsed Marcus's precise characterization of Hinton.
They do not establish that numerous researchers publicly criticized this particular interview.
